title.en: AI in Science: From Game Benchmarks to Research Workflows
title.zhHans: AI 的科学征程：从博弈基准到科研工作流

searchTitle.en: AI in Science Timeline (1997–2026): Deep Blue, AlphaFold, Nobel Prize, IMO Gold and SynthID Bio
searchTitle.zhHans: AI 科学时间线（1997—2026）：深蓝、AlphaFold、诺贝尔奖、IMO 金牌与 SynthID Bio

searchSummary.en: From Deep Blue and AlphaGo to AlphaFold’s 2024 Chemistry Nobel, IMO 2025 gold, SynthID Bio watermarking, assisted-research debates and Genie 4 world simulation.
searchSummary.zhHans: 从深蓝、AlphaGo 到 AlphaFold 获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖、IMO 金牌，再到 2026 年蛋白质水印、辅助科研争议与 Genie 4 世界模型。

subtitle.en: Closed-rule games, structural biology breakthroughs and the verification challenges of AI-assisted research
subtitle.zhHans: 封闭规则博弈、结构生物学突破，以及 AI 辅助科研的独立验证难题

abstract.en: Games with explicit rules—chess, Jeopardy!, Atari and Go—served for decades as controlled testbeds for search, statistical question answering and deep reinforcement learning. AlphaFold’s protein-structure predictions and the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry demonstrated that learned representations could solve a foundational problem in structural biology, while 2025 Olympiad reasoning scores showed general-purpose language models tackling competition mathematics. Yet 2026 developments in biological watermarking, vendor-announced mathematical results, R&D uplift audits and interactive world simulation highlight a sharper boundary: specialized scientific utility is proven, whereas claims of autonomous end-to-end discovery still hinge on independent replication and unredacted evidence.
abstract.zhHans: 国际象棋、Jeopardy!、Atari 与围棋等规则明确的博弈环境，曾长期充当检验搜索、统计问答与深度强化学习的受控试验场。AlphaFold 在蛋白质结构预测上的突破及 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖证明，深度学习表征能够攻克结构生物学的基础难题；2025 年国际数学奥林匹克（IMO）金牌成绩则展示了通用推理模型在竞赛数学上的能力。但 2026 年围绕蛋白质生物水印、厂商发布的科研成果、研发提速审计与交互式世界模型的进展凸显出更清晰的边界：特定科学工具的价值已获实证，而“端到端自主科学发现”主张仍高度依赖独立复现与未删减的原始证据。

title.en: Search and Statistical QA in Structured Games
title.zhHans: 结构化博弈中的高速搜索与统计问答

narrative.en: In May 1997, IBM’s Deep Blue became the first computer system to defeat a reigning world chess champion in a tournament match, relying on specialized parallel hardware and high-speed tree search. In February 2011, IBM’s Watson DeepQA system defeated human champions on Jeopardy!, combining natural-language parsing and statistical evidence scoring over unstructured text. Both milestones succeeded within well-bounded competition formats rather than open-ended scientific inquiry.
narrative.zhHans: 1997 年 5 月，IBM Deep Blue 借助专用并行硬件与高速博弈树搜索，成为首个在标准锦标赛条件下击败卫冕国际象棋世界冠军的计算机系统。2011 年 2 月，IBM Watson DeepQA 系统在电视智力竞赛 Jeopardy! 中战胜人类冠军，结合了自然语言解析与非结构化文本统计评分。这两项里程碑均在规则边界清晰的竞赛框架内达成，尚不同于开放式的科学探索。

keyInsight.en: Chess and quiz-show victories demonstrated domain-engineered search and statistical retrieval under fixed scoring rules.
keyInsight.zhHans: 国际象棋与智力竞赛的胜利，验证了固定计分规则下的领域工程搜索与统计检索能力。

title.en: Deep Reinforcement Learning and Self-Play in Go
title.zhHans: 深度强化学习与围棋自我对弈

narrative.en: In December 2013, DeepMind researchers introduced Deep Q-Networks learning control policies directly from raw pixel inputs on Atari games. Combining deep neural networks with Monte Carlo tree search and self-play, DeepMind’s AlphaGo subsequently mastered Go—a game whose vast state space precluded exhaustive brute-force search—and defeated top professional players in 2016.
narrative.zhHans: 2013 年 12 月，DeepMind 研究团队提出直接从高维像素输入学习控制策略的深度强化学习模型（DQN）。在此基础上，AlphaGo 将深度神经网络与蒙特卡洛树搜索及自我对弈相结合，攻克了因搜索空间巨大而无法靠穷举搜索解决的围棋难题，并于 2016 年击败顶尖职业棋手。

keyInsight.en: Combining learned value/policy networks with tree search made intractable state spaces tractable without hand-coded evaluation rules.
keyInsight.zhHans: 将学习到的价值/策略网络与树搜索结合，在不依赖人工编写评估规则的前提下攻克了超大状态空间决策问题。

title.en: From Acquired Lab to Atomic-Scale Protein Structure
title.zhHans: 从实验室并购到蛋白质三维结构预测

narrative.en: Following Google’s January 2014 acquisition of DeepMind, the lab applied deep learning architectures to structural biology. At CASP14 in November 2020—and in Jumper et al.’s 2021 Nature publication—AlphaFold demonstrated near-experimental accuracy in predicting 3D protein structures from amino-acid sequences, establishing an immediately reusable computational tool across structural biology.
narrative.zhHans: 继 Google 于 2014 年 1 月收购英国初创公司 DeepMind 后，该实验室将深度学习方法引入结构生物学。在 2020 年 11 月的 CASP14 竞赛及 2021 年发表于《Nature》的论文中，AlphaFold 实现了从氨基酸序列高精度预测蛋白质三维结构，成为生物医学界可直接复用的计算基础设施。

keyInsight.en: AlphaFold translated representation learning from synthetic game boards to an empirically validated physical measurement benchmark.
keyInsight.zhHans: AlphaFold 将表征学习从人造棋盘迁移至可通过实验结构直接核验的自然科学问题。

title.en: Nobel Recognition and Certified Olympiad Reasoning
title.zhHans: 诺贝尔奖认可与受核证的奥赛数学推理

narrative.en: In October 2024, the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences awarded the Nobel Prize in Chemistry half to David Baker for computational protein design and half jointly to Demis Hassabis and John Jumper for protein structure prediction. In July 2025, Google DeepMind reported that an advanced Gemini Deep Think model scored 35 out of 42 points—gold-medal standard—on the 2025 International Mathematical Olympiad using natural-language reasoning graded by IMO coordinators, while noting that IMO coordinator confirmation covered the submitted solutions rather than independent validation of DeepMind’s internal system pipeline.
narrative.zhHans: 2024 年 10 月，瑞典皇家科学院将诺贝尔化学奖一半授予从事计算蛋白质设计的 David Baker，另一半共同授予凭 AlphaFold 突破蛋白质结构预测的 Demis Hassabis 与 John Jumper。2025 年 7 月，Google DeepMind 宣布其增强版 Gemini Deep Think 纯自然语言推理模型在 2025 年国际数学奥林匹克（IMO）中获协调员按正式标准评定 35 分（满分 42 分，达金牌线），同时明确说明 IMO 协调员仅确认提交解答的正确性，并不延伸至对其内部系统流程的验证。

keyInsight.en: Institutional recognition for AlphaFold and graded Olympiad proofs marked major milestones, while solution grading remains distinct from full pipeline replication.
keyInsight.zhHans: 诺贝尔化学奖与经官方评阅的奥赛金牌构成重要里程碑，但单次解答核验仍不同于完整研发管线的独立复现。

title.en: Bio-Watermarking, Assisted Research Audits and World Simulation
title.zhHans: 生物设计溯源、科研提速审计与世界模拟

narrative.en: Late 2026 showed scientific AI diversifying into biosecurity provenance, contested research-acceleration claims and interactive simulation. On September 30, Google DeepMind introduced SynthID Bio, demonstrating watermarked de novo protein binders while cautioning that no single biosecurity tool is a silver bullet. On October 26, OpenAI announced three AI-assisted results across math, computer science and physics guided by external academic 'shepherds,' prompting scrutiny over how human framing versus model autonomy is credited. On November 5, METR estimated Anthropic’s internal AI R&D speed at roughly 1.9x its pre-October 2025 rate (95% CI: 1.5–2.8x) while warning that Anthropic redacted a majority of the most informative underlying evidence. Meanwhile, Google DeepMind launched its Genie 4 interactive world model in October research preview—explicitly calling it early and experimental—before rolling it out to eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers in Project Genie on November 18 and to paid-tier developers via the Gemini API and Google AI Studio on November 19.
narrative.zhHans: 2026 年秋冬的进展将科学 AI 推向生物安全溯源、辅助科研归因争议与交互式世界模拟三条分支。9 月 30 日，Google DeepMind 发布 SynthID Bio，在保持生物结合活性的前提下首次为从头设计的蛋白质嵌入水印，同时坦言单一干预并非生物安全万能药。10 月 26 日，OpenAI 宣布在外部学者“引导人”（shepherds）协助下取得数学、计算机与物理三项成果，引发学界对人类选题引导与模型独立贡献边界的审视。11 月 5 日，评估机构 METR 估算 Anthropic 内部研发速度约为 2025 年 10 月前的 1.9 倍（95% 置信区间 1.5–2.8 倍），但明确指出 Anthropic 隐去了大部分最关键的底层证据。同期，Google DeepMind 在 10 月推出交互式世界模型 Genie 4 研究预览（自陈仍属早期实验模型），继而于 11 月 18 日在 Project Genie 中向符合条件的 Google AI Ultra 订阅用户推送，并于 11 月 19 日通过 Gemini API 与 Google AI Studio 向付费层开发者开放。

keyInsight.en: As AI enters protein design, theorem proving and world simulation, provenance watermarks and unredacted external audits matter as much as headline results.
keyInsight.zhHans: 随着 AI 深入蛋白质设计、定理推导与物理世界模拟，溯源水印与未删减的第三方独立审计已与成果发布本身同等关键。

conclusion.en: Nearly three decades after Deep Blue, AI has moved from winning closed-rule games to predicting biomolecular structures at scale, solving competition math problems and generating interactive simulated environments. Yet the 2026 evidence resists treating every vendor research announcement as autonomous scientific discovery: human problem framing, redacted internal logs and early simulation fidelity limits mean independent replication and transparent methodology remain the decisive scientific standard.
conclusion.zhHans: 距 Deep Blue 夺冠近三十年后，AI 已从赢得封闭规则博弈，发展到规模化预测生物大分子结构、解答奥赛数学题并生成可交互模拟环境。但 2026 年的证据同样提醒我们，不能把每一次厂商科研发布直接等同于全自主科学发现：人类专家的问题框定、受删减的内部评估日志以及世界模型的早期实验局限表明，独立复现与方法学透明仍是科学判断的最终准绳。
